steps.title: Blend the batter
steps.body: Combine in blender: **6 eggs**, **½ cup sugar**, **½ cup flour**, **¼ cup vegetable oil**, **¼ cup milk**, **¼ tsp salt** and **1 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Blend and cook
steps.body: Blend in well, then cook on griddle.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Top with butter and powdered sugar.
